title: preserve Pi-chan position on wave/level advance
problem_statement: Pi-chan is reset to center on wave/level advance because loadLevel recreates Player at default coordinates.
game_flow_context: wave completion and next-level transition only
validated_decisions: Preserve only x/y on wave-complete level advance.
Do not preserve bullets, boost, cooldown or other Player runtime state.
Default load/reset/goto/continue behavior remains centered unless explicitly passed a position.
draft_assumptions_in_play: A new Player at prior coordinates is safer than reusing the old Player object.
Preserved coordinates should be constrained to the new arena.
current_direction: Pass prior player position only from the isWaveComplete next-level path.
backward_compatibility_concerns: Other loadLevel callers must preserve current behavior.
Position must not be outside the newly built arena.
required_validations: PHPMD not applicable unless PHP/config is present
human_test_checklist: verify next level starts at same constrained position
verify reset/goto/continue do not inherit stale position
solution_applied: LevelManager creates a fresh Player at the provided x/y when present and constrains it into the new arena.
main.js passes current Pi-chan x/y only from the wave-complete next-level path.
Reset, goto, continue, spawn, Speed Dot and progression rules remain unchanged.
decision_log_summary: Created direct APPROVED_FOR_BUILD thread for a tiny wave-transition position preservation patch.
Build completed and reviewed with APPROVE_WITH_NOTES.
